decisions.question: Using the parity-correct setup-learning method, does the raw generation actor reliably learn an independently generated synthetic setup landscape within 64 setup updates?
decisions.status: accepted as PROCEED by the operator on 2026-09-02 (synthetic trainability portion of G2 only); branch phase18/g2-raw-confirmation published at d0fd36d9 (local == remote); Gate G2 is CLOSED together with the parity evidence accepted under P18-D004; G3 is UNSTARTED and not authorized by this packet
decisions.headline: fresh landscape (optimum 53.031081), fresh seeds, unchanged G2 method: the raw actor improved in every seed, pooled paired 95% [+5.2985, +5.5585] on 12,288 pairs, gap closure 10.648% / 10.007% / 9.599%, median 10.007% against the frozen 10% threshold (cleared by 0.0073 percentage points); parity, bitwise replay, binding and integrity all pass; EMA telemetry median 0.119%, decides nothing -> PROCEED for the synthetic trainability portion of G2 only
decisions.scope: closes only the synthetic trainability portion of G2; authorizes designing the next gate, not launching G3, a Stratego game experiment or the full warmstart

decisions.gate_closure: G2 CLOSED on 2026-09-02: P18-D004 (accepted REVISE) established implementation parity and P18-D005 (accepted PROCEED) established synthetic trainability of the raw actor. No G3 run, Stratego setup-learning game, Phase 8 warmstart training or tuning is authorized.
decisions.margin_caveat: the median gap closure 10.0073% clears the frozen 10% threshold by 0.0073 percentage points (about 0.004 utility units on the median seed; seed 3 alone is below at 9.5987%). Accepted as frozen, but recorded as NOT robust evidence for a precise 10% practical effect: the margin is a fraction of a landscape-dependent gap. The learning effect itself is strong and replicated in all three seeds (pooled paired 95% [+5.2985, +5.5585] on 12,288 pairs). The next gate's margin must be sized in the units the gate is scored in, from a known instrument resolution.
